name: andre1337's Expansion Pack
description_html:
andre1337’s Expansion Pack

This mod focuses on adding some new attachments, as well as allow for some vanilla weapons to have new attachments.

If you want the AS VAL MOD.3 dust cover to be available for the vanilla AS VAL, you must install SamSWAT’s VAL MOD.3 mod.

First, before you dive in into the list of changes, I want to say that the content from my old Boomsticks mod will be implemented to this mod in the near future.

All the added items are available at Mechanic LL1.

New items

  • Zenitco RK-1 (Short): A shorter RK-1, ported from zhorabzhora’s old TKPD mod
  • KIBA Arms Multi-Caliber suppressor: Ported from zhorabzhora’s old TKPD mod as well, made to fit several calibers
  • 6 inch M-LOK handguard: Ported from Carl’s old Q Honey Badger mod, made to fit in the AR-15 platform
  • 12 inch M-LOK handguard: Ported from Carl’s old Q Honey Badger mod, made to fit in the AR-15 platform

Modifications to existing items/weapons

  • The AS-VAL got some love! You can now fit the RPK-16’s buffer tube to it, allowing you to ditch that horrendous Rotor 43 grip/tube combo, as well as now allowing you to fit (almost) any pistol grip from the AK family. Cool, right?
  • The NcStar MPR45 mount can now also fit some ATPIAL devices, such as the Perst-3, AN/PEQ-2 and 15, as well as the LA5B. Tacti-cool has gotten tacti-cooler.

- Credits

  • Carl for their amazing Q Honey Badger mod
  • Zhorabzhora for their amazing TKPD Carbine mod

Too bad their mods haven’t been updated to the newer AKI versions.
